panels.title: Identity
panels.description: The run's start, state changes, configuration and end, from the run log.

panels.title: Tick and tick rate
panels.description:
Which simulation tick the run has reached, and how fast it is advancing.

- **tick**: the latest tick.
- **ticks/s**: ticks completed per second of wall time.

panels.title: Population (sampled)
panels.description:
Living creatures.

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Mean energy (sampled)
panels.description:
Mean stored energy per living creature.

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Structure means (sampled)
panels.description:
Population means of brain and genome size.

- **genome size**: genome units per creature. Every unit costs energy to carry.
- **mesh nodes**: brain nodes per creature.
- **generation**: how many ancestors back to a founder, on average.

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Deaths by cause (rate)
panels.description:
Deaths per second, by the cost that took the creature's energy to zero.

- **lifecycle_decay**: the flat metabolic cost every creature pays each tick.
- **genome_carrying**: the per-tick cost of carrying a large genome.
- **capacity_upkeep**: the per-tick cost of a body that stores more energy than the reference body.
- **vm_compute / graph_compute**: the cost of running the brain's VM or graph nodes.
- **mesh_ramp**: the rising cost of brain hops beyond the free allowance in one tick.
- **priority_bid**: energy bid to act earlier in the turn order.
- **action_<kind>**: the effort cost of that action (eat, move, noop, reproduce, steal_energy, give_energy).
- **parental_transfer**: energy handed to offspring at reproduction.
- **predation**: drained by an attacker's StealEnergy.
- **gift**: gave its own energy away.
- **external_removal**: removed from outside while it still had energy.
- **unattributed**: reached zero with no recorded cause.
- **failed_action_penalty, hebbian_learning, reward_learning**: appear only in older runs. Current builds no longer use them.

panels.title: Births (rate)
panels.description: Children delivered per second (after any gestation).

panels.title: Mutation events (rate)
panels.description:
Mutation events per second at birth.

- **attempted**: an operator was drawn for the child's genome.
- **applied**: it changed the genome.
- **skipped**: it changed nothing (no target, or the result was invalid and rolled back).

panels.title: Energy flows by flow (delta over 1m)
panels.description:
Every energy flow in the world over each minute, by flow. The Exchange and Reserves rows split out the newer flows.

Debits leave creatures, credits enter them. The values are energy summed over the minute.

- **lifecycle_decay, genome_carrying, vm_compute, graph_compute, mesh_ramp, priority_bid**: running costs (debits). See Deaths by cause for each.
- **capacity_upkeep**: upkeep on stored-energy capacity. Negative when bodies are smaller than the reference.
- **action_charge.<action>**: effort paid for each action kind (debit).
- **failed_action_effort.<action>**: the part of action_charge spent on attempts that failed.
- **food_intake.<N>**: energy eaten from food type N (credit).
- **parental_transfer_debit / offspring_energy_credit**: energy a parent pays into a litter, and what the child receives.
- **offspring_capacity_overflow**: litter energy above the child's capacity, lost at birth.
- **gestation_lost**: litter energy lost when a birth fails (parent died, no free cell, population cap).
- **predation_victim_debit / predation_attacker_credit / predation_kill_bonus_credit**: energy stolen, energy gained, and the bonus for a kill.
- **gift_debit / gift_credit**: energy a giver pays out, and what recipients take in before their cap.
- **maximum_energy_clamp_loss**: energy discarded because a creature was already full.
- **zero_floor_credit**: energy added back when a creature overdrew below zero (it dies at zero).
- **external_removal_loss**: energy held by creatures removed from outside.

panels.title: Phase wall clock share
panels.description:
Share of the simulation's wall time spent in each phase of a tick.

- **food_growth**: food regrowth across the map.
- **world_update**: ageing, decay, memory decay and removing the dead.
- **sensor_assembly**: building every creature's sensor inputs.
- **cognition**: running the brains (in parallel).
- **actions**: carrying out the chosen actions, one creature at a time.
- **reward_learning**: reward-modulated learning after actions.

panels.title: Actions per tick (sampled)
panels.description:
Actions chosen in the latest tick, by kind.

- **move**: step to a neighbouring cell.
- **eat**: eat food on the creature's cell.
- **noop**: do nothing (still costs the effort floor).
- **reproduce**: start a litter.
- **steal**: StealEnergy: take energy from a creature in a neighbouring cell.
- **give**: GiveEnergy: pass energy to a creature in a neighbouring cell.

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Compute means (sampled)
panels.description:
Mean brain running cost per creature in the latest tick, in energy units.

- **total**: VM + graph + hop (mesh_ramp) cost, over creatures that ran their brain.
- **vm**: VM node cost, over creatures that ran a VM node.
- **graph**: graph node cost, over creatures that ran a graph node.

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Food density by type (sampled)
panels.description:
Total food on the map, by food type.

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Barrier bumps next to a barrier, by barrier reader
panels.description:
Of the moves made while standing next to a barrier, the share that walked into it, over a 1m window.

- **has_barrier_reader**: the creature's live brain contains a node that reads a barrier sensor. It has the sensor, whether or not it acts on it.
- **no_barrier_reader**: it has no barrier sensor in its live brain.

If creatures with the sensor bump as often as creatures without it, the sensor is not shaping their movement.

targets.expr: (sum by (petri_reader_state) (rate(petri_run_move_blocked_barrier_with_barrier_neighbor_by_reader_state_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m])) or 0 * sum by (petri_reader_state) (rate(petri_run_move_attempts_with_barrier_neighbor_by_reader_state_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m]))) / sum by (petri_reader_state) (rate(petri_run_move_attempts_with_barrier_neighbor_by_reader_state_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m]))

panels.title: Barrier bumps next to a barrier, run so far
panels.description:
Of the moves made while standing next to a barrier, the share that walked into it. Totals since the run started.

- **has_barrier_reader**: the creature's live brain contains a node that reads a barrier sensor. It has the sensor, whether or not it acts on it.
- **no_barrier_reader**: it has no barrier sensor in its live brain.

If creatures with the sensor bump as often as creatures without it, the sensor is not shaping their movement.

targets.expr: (sum by (petri_reader_state) (last_over_time(petri_run_move_blocked_barrier_with_barrier_neighbor_by_reader_state_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (petri_reader_state) (last_over_time(petri_run_move_attempts_with_barrier_neighbor_by_reader_state_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[$__range]))) / sum by (petri_reader_state) (last_over_time(petri_run_move_attempts_with_barrier_neighbor_by_reader_state_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Barrier bumps next to a barrier, by tick
panels.description:
The barrier bump share over a 1m window.

Plotted against simulation tick instead of wall time, so runs at different speeds line up.

- **has_barrier_reader**: the creature's live brain contains a node that reads a barrier sensor. It has the sensor, whether or not it acts on it.
- **no_barrier_reader**: it has no barrier sensor in its live brain.

Readers dropping below non-readers means the sensor is shaping movement. Overlapping lines mean it is not.

panels.title: Offspring per removed creature, by cognitive class
panels.description:
Offspring per creature, over creatures that have died or been removed so far. Living creatures are not counted.

Each removed creature gets the first class it matches, in this order. The order is bookkeeping, not an ability ranking.

- **plasticity**: carries a learning rule on a reachable graph node.
- **stateful**: has a node that keeps state between ticks (integrator, momentum, oscillator or adaptive gain).
- **shared_memory**: reads or writes shared memory slots.
- **none**: none of the above. A purely reactive brain.

panels.title: Lifespan of removed creatures, by cognitive class
panels.description:
Age at removal in ticks, averaged over creatures that have died or been removed so far. Living creatures are not counted.

Each removed creature gets the first class it matches, in this order. The order is bookkeeping, not an ability ranking.

- **plasticity**: carries a learning rule on a reachable graph node.
- **stateful**: has a node that keeps state between ticks (integrator, momentum, oscillator or adaptive gain).
- **shared_memory**: reads or writes shared memory slots.
- **none**: none of the above. A purely reactive brain.

panels.title: Eat hit rate, by food type
panels.description: Of the Eat actions that name a food type, the share that found that food on the cell. A low hit rate means creatures eat without checking what is under them.

targets.expr: (sum by (petri_food_type) (rate(petri_run_eat_actions_applied_by_type_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m])) or 0 * sum by (petri_food_type) (rate(petri_run_eat_actions_failed_by_type_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m]))) / ((sum by (petri_food_type) (rate(petri_run_eat_actions_applied_by_type_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m])) or 0 * sum by (petri_food_type) (rate(petri_run_eat_actions_failed_by_type_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m]))) + (sum by (petri_food_type) (rate(petri_run_eat_actions_failed_by_type_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m])) or 0 * sum by (petri_food_type) (rate(petri_run_eat_actions_applied_by_type_total{petri_run_id="$run_id"}[1m]))))

panels.title: Food eaten, by food type (rate)
panels.description: Eat actions that consumed food, per second, by the food type eaten. Shows what the population actually harvests.

panels.title: Blocked moves, share of all moves, by cause
panels.description:
Of the moves executed, the share that left the creature where it was, by what blocked it.

- **barrier**: a barrier was in the way.
- **occupied**: another creature was on the cell.
- **out_of_bounds**: the move would have left the world.

panels.title: Predation attempts, by result (rate)
panels.description:
StealEnergy (predation) actions per second, by outcome.

- **Transferred**: energy was taken and the victim survived.
- **TransferredAndKilled**: the victim was drained to zero and died.
- **RejectedNoVictim**: the target cell was empty, a barrier or off the map.
- **RejectedNothingToTake**: there was a victim, but no energy moved.

panels.title: Parent age at birth (1m window)
panels.description:
The parent's age in ticks when each child was delivered, over births in the last minute.

- **p10 / median / p90**: 10th, 50th and 90th percentile over all births.
- **median, first births**: only each parent's first child: age at first reproduction.

Percentiles are estimated within histogram buckets (bounds 20 to 5,000 ticks). Anything above 5,000 reads as 5,000.

panels.title: Parent age at birth, run so far
panels.description: Births over the whole time range by the parent's age at delivery, in ticks. Each bar is one age bucket, labelled by its upper bound. +Inf holds ages above 5,000.

panels.title: Mean parent age at birth, run so far, by birth order
panels.description:
Mean parent age at delivery, in ticks, over every birth in the time range.

- **first**: each parent's first child (age at first reproduction).
- **later**: every child after that.

panels.title: Drive carriers, share of population, by kind (sampled)
panels.description:
Share of living creatures whose live brain has at least one connection into an action's drive sink.

A brain votes for a directed action in one of eight directions (**direction sinks**). A **drive sink** is a ninth vote, "do this action at all", added to whichever direction is winning.

- **move / reproduce / steal_energy / give_energy**: the four directed action kinds.

Founders have no drive connections, so any rise came from mutation and was kept by selection. Having a drive is structure, not use: the drive can still lose the vote.

panels.title: Direction fan-outs, share of population, by kind (sampled)
panels.description:
Share of living creatures that wire one source into two or more of an action's eight direction sinks. That duplication is what a single drive connection replaces.

A brain votes for a directed action in one of eight directions (**direction sinks**). A **drive sink** is a ninth vote, "do this action at all", added to whichever direction is winning.

- **move / reproduce / steal_energy / give_energy**: the four directed action kinds.

Founders carry move and reproduce fan-outs. Drive carriers rising while fan-outs fall is the shift drives were added for.

panels.title: Drive carriers by tick (sampled)
panels.description:
The drive-carrier shares.

Plotted against simulation tick instead of wall time, so runs at different speeds line up.

A brain votes for a directed action in one of eight directions (**direction sinks**). A **drive sink** is a ninth vote, "do this action at all", added to whichever direction is winning.

- **move / reproduce / steal_energy / give_energy**: the four directed action kinds.

panels.title: Give attempts, by result (rate)
panels.description:
GiveEnergy actions per second, by outcome.

- **Transferred**: energy moved to the recipient.
- **RejectedNoRecipient**: no creature was on the target cell.
- **RejectedNothingToGive**: the giver had no energy left after paying the action's effort.

panels.title: Give attempts, by result, run so far
panels.description:
Each outcome's share of the run's GiveEnergy attempts. Totals since the run started.

- **Transferred**: energy moved to the recipient.
- **RejectedNoRecipient**: no creature was on the target cell.
- **RejectedNothingToGive**: the giver had no energy left after paying the action's effort.

panels.title: Give success share
panels.description: Of the GiveEnergy attempts in each minute, the share that moved energy to a recipient.

panels.title: Gift energy flows (delta over 1m)
panels.description:
Energy moved by gifts over each minute.

- **gift_debit**: energy the givers paid out.
- **gift_credit**: energy the recipients took in, before their capacity cap.

When the lines overlap, recipients had room for every gift. A gap is energy lost to full recipients.

panels.title: Reserve energy flows (delta over 1m)
panels.description:
Energy flows tied to how much energy a body can store, over each minute.

- **capacity_upkeep**: the per-tick cost of a body's storage capacity, relative to the reference body. Negative means bodies smaller than the reference are being refunded.
- **offspring_capacity_overflow**: litter energy above a newborn's capacity, lost at birth.

panels.title: Capacity upkeep deaths, share of all deaths
panels.description: Of the deaths in each minute, the share caused by capacity upkeep: the creature paid for more storage than it could keep filled.

panels.title: Mean capacity and mean energy (sampled)
panels.description:
Storage room against what is actually stored.

- **mean capacity**: the most energy a creature can hold, averaged over the living. It is inherited and mutates.
- **mean energy**: energy actually held, averaged over the living.

The gap is unused storage, which still costs upkeep.

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Weight changes per creature-tick, by kind
panels.description:
Weight changes per creature-tick over a 1m window: how much learning actually moves weights.

- **hebbian**: pure Hebbian. Updates from activity alone, after every graph visit.
- **reward-modulated**: three-factor learning. Activity is held in a fading eligibility trace and becomes a weight change only when the edge's outcome signal (energy change, action success, damage or offspring) is nonzero. Applied once per tick, after actions.

A change counts when the stored weight differs from before. This is activity, not benefit: a weight can move on an edge that feeds nothing.

panels.title: Plasticity updates per creature-tick, by kind
panels.description:
Learning updates per creature-tick, whether or not the weight changed. Rises with both how many creatures learn and how busy each one is.

- **hebbian**: pure Hebbian. Updates from activity alone, after every graph visit.
- **reward-modulated**: three-factor learning. Activity is held in a fading eligibility trace and becomes a weight change only when the edge's outcome signal (energy change, action success, damage or offspring) is nonzero. Applied once per tick, after actions.

Hebbian counts once per plastic edge per graph visit, so ticks with several brain passes count more than once. Reward-modulated counts once per initialized edge per tick, even when the outcome signal is 0.

panels.title: Share of plasticity updates that change a weight, by kind
panels.description:
Of the learning updates, the share that changed a weight, over a 1m window.

- **hebbian**: pure Hebbian. Updates from activity alone, after every graph visit.
- **reward-modulated**: three-factor learning. Activity is held in a fading eligibility trace and becomes a weight change only when the edge's outcome signal (energy change, action success, damage or offspring) is nonzero. Applied once per tick, after actions.

A low share means most updates write the same value back: no activity, a zero outcome signal, or a weight already at its clamp (its maximum).

panels.title: Plasticity per creature-tick, run so far
panels.description:
Learning updates and weight changes per creature-tick, over the run so far.

- **hebbian**: pure Hebbian. Updates from activity alone, after every graph visit.
- **reward-modulated**: three-factor learning. Activity is held in a fading eligibility trace and becomes a weight change only when the edge's outcome signal (energy change, action success, damage or offspring) is nonzero. Applied once per tick, after actions.

Learning costs no energy, so it has no energy flow.

panels.title: Weight changes per creature-tick by tick
panels.description:
Weight changes per creature-tick.

Plotted against simulation tick instead of wall time, so runs at different speeds line up.

- **hebbian**: pure Hebbian. Updates from activity alone, after every graph visit.
- **reward-modulated**: three-factor learning. Activity is held in a fading eligibility trace and becomes a weight change only when the edge's outcome signal (energy change, action success, damage or offspring) is nonzero. Applied once per tick, after actions.

panels.title: Plasticity carriers, share of population (sampled)
panels.description:
Share of living creatures with at least one plastic (learning) edge in their live brain.

Founders carry none, so any rise came from mutation and was kept by selection. Carrying an edge is structure, not use: it learns only when its brain node runs.

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Mean drift per plastic edge, by surface (sampled)
panels.description:
How far learning has moved weights: the mean of |learned − birth weight| per plastic edge, by where the edge points.

- **compute**: an edge into a compute node, inside the brain graph.
- **sink**: an edge into an output sink: an action vote, a memory write or a gate.

An edge that has not learned yet adds 0. Lamarckian edges start from the parent's learned weight, so their drift also carries what ancestors learned.

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Plastic edges at their clamp, share by surface (sampled)
panels.description:
Share of learned weights stuck at their clamp (the ± maximum each edge allows, between 0.01 and 10), by where the edge points.

- **compute**: an edge into a compute node, inside the brain graph.
- **sink**: an edge into an output sink: an action vote, a memory write or a gate.

A high share means learning saturates instead of tracking its inputs. Covariance with large inputs can hit the clamp in one tick.

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Plastic edges by rule (sampled)
panels.description:
Plastic edges in the living population, by learning rule: the mix of rules selection keeps.

- **classic**: plain Hebbian learning. The weight grows when its input and the node are active together (Δw = rate × in × out).
- **anti_hebb**: the reverse. Activity together weakens the weight (Δw = −rate × in × out).
- **oja**: Hebbian with a brake. Growth slows as the weight gets large, so it settles instead of running away (Δw = rate × out × (in − w × out)).
- **covariance**: learns from distance to the midpoint 0.5. Input and node both above or both below it strengthen the weight; one above and one below weakens it (Δw = rate × (in − 0.5) × (out − 0.5)).

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Plasticity carriers by tick (sampled)
panels.description:
The plasticity-carrier share.

Plotted against simulation tick instead of wall time, so runs at different speeds line up.

panels.title: Plastic edges by scope (sampled)
panels.description:
Plastic edges in the living population, by what they learn.

A **group** is a set of brain edges that share one weight, the group's scale (for example the eight edges from a sensor ring into the eight move directions).

- **ungrouped**: the edge is in no group and learns its own weight.
- **edge**: a group member that learns its own correction on top of the shared scale.
- **group**: a group member that learns the group's shared scale, moving all members together.

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Mean learned-scale drift, by inheritance (sampled)
panels.description:
How far learning has moved group scales: mean |learned − birth scale|, counted once per group.

A **group** is a set of brain edges that share one weight, the group's scale (for example the eight edges from a sensor ring into the eight move directions).

- **darwinian**: children start from the genome's birth value. What the parent learned dies with it.
- **lamarckian**: children start from the parent's learned value, so learning is passed down.

A scale that has not learned yet adds 0.

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Learned scales at their bound, share by inheritance (sampled)
panels.description:
Share of learned group scales stuck at their bound (the smallest clamp among the group's learners).

A **group** is a set of brain edges that share one weight, the group's scale (for example the eight edges from a sensor ring into the eight move directions).

- **darwinian**: children start from the genome's birth value. What the parent learned dies with it.
- **lamarckian**: children start from the parent's learned value, so learning is passed down.

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Plastic edges, share by retention (sampled)
panels.description:
Plastic edges, split by how fast they forget, as a share of all plastic edges.

Every tick a learned value slides back toward its birth value. The label is how much of the learned change it loses per tick:

- **none**: loses nothing. Learning lasts the whole life.
- **1e-3**: loses under 0.1% per tick (slow forgetting).
- **1e-2**: 0.1% to 1% per tick.
- **1e-1**: 1% to 10% per tick.
- **1**: 10% to 100% per tick (forgets within a few ticks).

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Learned scales, share by retention (sampled)
panels.description:
Learned group scales, split by how fast they forget, as a share of all learned scales.

A **group** is a set of brain edges that share one weight, the group's scale (for example the eight edges from a sensor ring into the eight move directions).

Every tick a learned value slides back toward its birth value. The label is how much of the learned change it loses per tick:

- **none**: loses nothing. Learning lasts the whole life.
- **1e-3**: loses under 0.1% per tick (slow forgetting).
- **1e-2**: 0.1% to 1% per tick.
- **1e-1**: 1% to 10% per tick.
- **1**: 10% to 100% per tick (forgets within a few ticks).

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Plastic edges by inheritance (sampled)
panels.description:
Plastic edges in the living population, by whether children inherit what was learned.

- **darwinian**: children start from the genome's birth value. What the parent learned dies with it.
- **lamarckian**: children start from the parent's learned value, so learning is passed down.

Sampled at each snapshot.

panels.title: Mutations applied, top 8 operators (rate)
panels.description:
Applied mutation events per second for the eight busiest operators at each moment. The legend lists every operator that was in the top eight at some point.

Operator names read `Family.Operator`. The family says which part of the genome the operator changes:

- **Topology**: the brain's node network: which node runs next (routes), the entry node, gate biases.
- **Graph**: inside a graph node: compute nodes, edges and weights, groups and learning settings.
- **Vm**: inside a VM node: its instruction program, constants, registers and memory addresses.
- **InputRef**: which sensors a node reads (add, prune, swap, retune).

panels.title: Mutations applied, top 12 operators, run so far
panels.description:
Each operator's share of the run's applied mutation events, the twelve largest. Totals since the run started.

Operator names read `Family.Operator`. The family says which part of the genome the operator changes:

- **Topology**: the brain's node network: which node runs next (routes), the entry node, gate biases.
- **Graph**: inside a graph node: compute nodes, edges and weights, groups and learning settings.
- **Vm**: inside a VM node: its instruction program, constants, registers and memory addresses.
- **InputRef**: which sensors a node reads (add, prune, swap, retune).

panels.title: Mutations skipped, by reason (rate)
panels.description:
Mutation events per second that drew an operator but changed nothing, by reason.

- **NoApplicableTarget**: the genome had nothing that operator can act on.
- **ParseabilityViolation**: the result would not be a valid genome.
- **NumericProposalRejected**: the proposed number was out of range.
- **GraphInvariantViolation**: the change broke a brain-graph rule and was rolled back.

panels.title: Attribute changes, by scope (rate)
panels.description:
Mutations to learning settings (rule, rate, retention, inheritance, scope and so on) per second, by how the edited edge learns.

A **group** is a set of brain edges that share one weight, the group's scale (for example the eight edges from a sensor ring into the eight move directions).

- **Edge**: the edge learns its own weight or correction.
- **Group**: the edge learns its group's shared scale.

panels.title: Edges detached and bundles removed (rate)
panels.description:
Mutations that take bundles apart, per second.

A **bundle** is a set of brain edges that share one weight, the bundle's scale (for example the eight edges from a sensor ring into the eight move directions).

- **edges detached**: an edge left its bundle and now carries its own weight.
- **bundles removed**: a whole bundle was dissolved.

panels.title: Births inheriting a pair-group scale
panels.description:
Of the births in each minute, the share whose genome holds a nonzero direction-pair group scale that no mutation at that birth could have made. The scale was inherited from the parent.

A direction-pair group turns a sensed x/y offset (such as nearest food) into votes for the eight directions.

panels.title: Genome size per creature-tick
panels.description: Mean genome size, weighted by how long each creature lived: genome units carried per creature-tick. This is the size the population actually paid carrying cost on.

panels.title: Population by tick (sampled)
panels.description:
Living creatures.

Plotted against simulation tick instead of wall time, so runs at different speeds line up.

panels.title: Mean energy by tick (sampled)
panels.description:
Mean stored energy per living creature.

Plotted against simulation tick instead of wall time, so runs at different speeds line up.

panels.title: Mean genome size by tick (sampled)
panels.description:
Mean genome units per creature.

Plotted against simulation tick instead of wall time, so runs at different speeds line up.

panels.title: Deaths by tick
panels.description:
Deaths so far.

Plotted against simulation tick instead of wall time, so runs at different speeds line up.

panels.title: Mutation events applied by tick
panels.description:
Applied mutation events so far.

Plotted against simulation tick instead of wall time, so runs at different speeds line up.

panels.title: Tick traces
panels.description: One row per tick trace of the run: its start, duration, tick and sample policy. Click the span ID to open the trace.

panels.title: Creature windows
panels.description: One row per creature window (a creature recorded tick by tick for a short stretch) or manual sample. Click the span ID to open the trace. Its tick spans carry the brain hops, passes and actions.

targets.query: { span.petri.run_id = "$run_id" && name = "creature_window" } | select(span.petri.window, span.petri.creature_id, span.petri.sample_policy, span.petri.ticks_recorded, span.petri.end_reason, span.petri.truncated)

panels.title: Sensors declared, share of population, by world input (sampled)
panels.description:
Share of living creatures whose live brain lists each sensor in its inputs, wired or not. Fixed at birth. Carried, not necessarily used.

`:N` names a food type.

- **FoodHere:N**: food density on the creature's own cell.
- **NeighborFoodRing:N**: food in each of the 8 neighbouring cells.
- **NeighborBarrierRing**: barriers in the 8 neighbouring cells.
